Option.IsEnabled.Label: Enable Mod
Option.IsEnabled.Desc: If enabled, the Asset Migration will run on startup every time a save is loaded.
Option.PerObjectLogging.Label: Per Object Logging
Option.PerObjectLogging.Desc: If enabled, the Asset Migration will log each object that is migrated. This can be useful for debugging, but may slow down the migration process.
Option.RunOnce.Label: Run Once
Option.RunOnce.Desc: Run the Asset Migration once manually.
Option.CleanupObsoleteEntities.Label: Cleanup Obsolete Entities
Option.CleanupObsoleteEntities.Desc: Cleanup obsolete entities from the game world. Triggers the game's own cleanup routine from the Developer Mode.
